answer: By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the river until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the crystal of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work.
